previous_credential.why_superseded: graded on models/curriculum/run_suite.py's tier-0 setup (refinement 2, 250 iterations, 45,813 cells), which is the MIDDLE rung of the act's own three-mesh ladder. The act's production mesh (79,778 cells) moves C_d from 0.0876 to 0.081547 and the deviation from 21% to 12%. The reference (0.26) and its band (±15%) did not move; the mesh did. Same STL, same freestream (40 m/s), same closure (k-omega SST).

grid_study.note: Three meshes of this case, same physics, run by the act: 20,425 / 45,813 / 79,778 cells at C_d 0.1061 / 0.0876 / 0.0815. Monotone, but the observed order comes out at 3.17, outside the theoretical range, so the ladder is recorded as not conclusive and the band is reported at the clamped order. That is what holds this credential at SOLVER-BACKED rather than VALIDATED; the published band itself is met at 12%.
